title: Witness (mutant, sigma) against a spec (protocol.md section 8)
description: A presented pair. The verifier re-evaluates it with specgame_core.evaluate_witness on Spec compiled over the mutant; `observed` is what the adversary saw and is never trusted.

mutant.description: Artifact identity: sha256 of the runtime bytecode of bare CappedToken compiled from the mutant.

pair_runtime_sha256.description: sha256 of the runtime bytecode of Spec compiled over the mutant.
